episode_inventory.source_paraphrase: Haguenau Intermarché reported cabinet readings of 32°C, approximately €50,000 in frozen-stock losses and an additional smaller chilled-stock loss. episode_inventory.source_paraphrase: Super U Mirepoix managers described a remote-monitoring warning at 2 am, staff attendance and a refrigeration technician arriving at 6 am. They reported approximately €90,000 in losses from the affected display areas; reserves and cold rooms remained unaffected. Warning delivery, repair attendance and the surviving stock are distinct observations. The source does not define a guaranteed protection threshold or establish why reserves escaped the interference.
episode_inventory.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A warning and human response show detection and intervention, but their existence alone does not establish the protective effect required of the particular control.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The reported monitoring warning reached people who responded, while some stock was still lost and reserves were unaffected. The missing facts are the control’s required protective purpose, applicable response time and the causal link between the response and the spared reserves. The outcome therefore establishes neither inadequate effect under this class nor a separately verified invariant-held result.

episode_inventory.source_paraphrase: Coopérative U’s president reported 80 affected stores and said most avoided a cold-chain break or stock destruction through the response of teams and refrigeration specialists. He also said a minority could not react or control the interference quickly enough. This does not establish that 80 stores lost stock, or that the same protective mechanism operated at every store.
episode_inventory.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Avoided harm is material evidence, but a successful control finding must identify the safeguard, its required effect and how it produced that protection.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The retailer’s account supports distinct protected and harmed outcomes. It does not identify the particular activated controls, their required protective levels or store-specific intervention traces. Those missing links prevent attributing the avoided losses to a validated control effect under this class; the observed response remains part of the occurrence.

episode_inventory.source_paraphrase: Intermarché La Haye-du-Puits reported approximately US$112,000 in discarded food and heat-affected equipment. These are attributed consequences at one store. The reported losses and hardware damage do not identify the remote command source, a participating AI system or a uniform national mechanism.
episode_inventory.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Material harm and mechanism attribution answer different questions. Preserve the store’s consequences without inferring an actor or a missing control from their severity.

episode_inventory.source_paraphrase: Censys observed 1,825 Internet-exposed Danfoss StoreView hosts in France on 11 October and 537 on 14 October. episode_inventory.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Network visibility, confirmed compromise and a validated repaired boundary are different states. Measurements of one state do not automatically establish the others.

The outcome therefore establishes neither inadequate effect under this class nor a separately verified invariant-held result.

episode_decisions_after.source_paraphrase: Coopérative U’s president reported 80 affected stores and said most avoided a cold-chain break or stock destruction through the response of teams and refrigeration specialists. He also said a minority could not react or control the interference quickly enough. This does not establish that 80 stores lost stock, or that the same protective mechanism operated at every store.
episode_decisions_after.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Avoided harm is material evidence, but a successful control finding must identify the safeguard, its required effect and how it produced that protection.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The retailer’s account supports distinct protected and harmed outcomes. It does not identify the particular activated controls, their required protective levels or store-specific intervention traces. Those missing links prevent attributing the avoided losses to a validated control effect under this class; the observed response remains part of the occurrence.

episode_decisions_after.source_paraphrase: Intermarché La Haye-du-Puits reported approximately US$112,000 in discarded food and heat-affected equipment. These are attributed consequences at one store. The reported losses and hardware damage do not identify the remote command source, a participating AI system or a uniform national mechanism.
episode_decisions_after.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Material harm and mechanism attribution answer different questions. Preserve the store’s consequences without inferring an actor or a missing control from their severity.

episode_decisions_after.source_paraphrase: Censys observed 1,825 Internet-exposed Danfoss StoreView hosts in France on 11 October and 537 on 14 October. These are two exposure measurements, not a count of compromised stores. A reduction in visible hosts does not by itself establish restoration, valid access control or attribution of the earlier commands.
episode_decisions_after.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Network visibility, confirmed compromise and a validated repaired boundary are different states. Measurements of one state do not automatically establish the others.
